summary: # CLO 2024.1 - Color Matching Editor ## Introduction to Qlou202.4.1 From the Qlou202.4.1 update, we optimized the function structure of Qlou202.4.1. This version allows for a more flexible implementation. In this video, let's learn in detail how to use Qlou202.4.1. ## Main Menu Structure Changes In this version, we have improved the main menu structure. Therefore, the position of Qlou202.4.1 has also changed. You can click on "Production" in the top menu and select Qlou202.4.1 in the drop-down menu to start using this function. ## Adding New Qlou202.4.1 Instances To add a new Qlou202.4.1, click on the plus sign in the upper right corner on the left. This is the same as the previous Qlou202.4.1. Under the settings of this add mode, you can change the color and texture. ### Material Properties In Qlou202.4.1, you can also set various material properties, such as the physical properties of the fabric, the shape of the button, and the lines applied in different Qlou202.4.1 instances. This function allows you to freely create more types of Qlou202.4.1. ## Adding Flags Click on the add button in the default setting on the right side. You will see the window to add Qlou202.4.1. In this window, you can check the materials used in the currently selected Qlou202.4.1, such as fabric, stickers, etc. The software will display according to the material type classification. You can define the settings and options of each module according to your own needs before adding a new Qlou202.4.1. ## Exploring the Options Next, let's take a look at the Qlou202.4.1 options in the window and see how to use them in different scenarios. You can use the button in the upper right corner to unify the materials that have been classified. You can also select the button on the right side of each material to do a separate setting. ### Material Properties and Links You can hover over the icon in the upper right corner to check the material, all properties, and link settings. If you want to know more about the content, you can also click on the handbook at the bottom to check the official website for instructions. ## Adding Flags and Settings Click on the add button at the bottom of the window to add a flag according to the current setting. Every time you click on the add button, you can add a flag. If you click on the add and close button, it will add a flag according to your settings and close the current window. If you need to add another flag, when you open the window again, all options will revert to default settings, and all will be set as material options. Please remember this in your work. ## Changing Fabric Texture To better show the difference between options, I will name the created flag as "Material." Next, we will change the main fabric texture of the baseball. Here, we only changed the material module information. Similarly, we can also adjust the property editor, its material type, and color. Click on the update button to see the zoom effect after the update. ## Properties Options Now, let's talk about all the properties options. When using this option, you need to pay attention to the flag color option. Each flag needs to use a separate fabric for its style. This option setting will be very useful when the button shape or size is involved. Now, select all properties, then press the add and close button at the bottom. Press the button to add the flag color. We changed this file name to "All Properties" to show the flag color design of the same paper with different materials. ## Button Shape and Sticker Adjustments Now let's give this style a change by modifying the shape of a button and adjusting the size of the sticker. If we want to change the direction of the current flag color sticker, you can choose the sticker in the 3D window. In the attribute editor on the right side, find all flag colors in the link. After removing the link of the angle, you can continue to modify the angle of the current sticker. ### Angle and Position Settings Under default settings, angle and position are the same. You can also change the angle and position freely if you remove the link of these two options, allowing you to set and create the position and angle of the sticker in each flag color. ## Link Option Let's take a look at the link option. This setting can be done without changing its properties. You can copy a flag color scheme. When you create a flag color, the fabric of the flag color scheme you choose will have the same material as the sticker. You can use this option for that purpose. ## Creating a Linked Flag Color Next, we create a link flag color to demonstrate. When we click add and close, we can choose a material in the flag color editor. The selected material will link to yellow highlights. If we change the color of the sleeve, you can also change the color. ### Checking Flag Color Information You can open and close all flag colors through the object window. When you open and show all flag colors, you can check all the flag color information of the material directly in the object window without needing to open the flag color editor. ## Object Window Features In the object window, we can open and close to show all flag colors. When you open this function, below each object, there will be all the flag colors. You can click the water drop icon in the upper left corner to activate the flag color display of all objects, or click the water drop icon in front of each object to display and hide the flag color information. ### Color Block Highlighting When you open and show all flag colors, the color block of the current flag color application will use a white border highlight display to remind you which flag color you are editing. When you hover over the color block, the name of all color matching options used by the object will appear. ## Material Type Flag Color For the flag colors added to the material and link mode, there will be a corresponding color block below each object showing the flag color information. For the flag color of the material type, you can change the material attribute separately, such as texture and color. The color block only shows the name of this flag color. ### All Attributes Type Flag Color If it is the flag color of the link mode, it will list all the flag color names of the link mode. If it is the flag color of the all attributes type, the color block will prompt "not used" as if it is not activated. ## Color Scheme Management If you slide down the wheel in the object window, you will see through all attributes settings to add a color scheme for a single project. You will notice that the color blocks other than the color scheme will be marked as "not used." This applies not only to the fabric but also to the sticker, button, eye, thread, and sewing needle. ### Checking Without the Editor Therefore, you do not need to open the flag color editor; you can easily check them. Below, I will share the edit operation in the flag color editor and related improvements. You can drag the fabric, stickers, and accessories from the object window and apply them to the 3D window, clothes, or on the board. The material properties will be applied to the object. ## Modifying Applied Objects For all the colors applied to the objects, you can set different textures and colors for each color. If you are in the object window, you can drag the project file while holding the control key on the keyboard, then release the left mouse button to apply it to the project file. ### Linking and Modifying Properties This way, the object will use the link property, and all flag colors will be modified at the same time when changing properties in one of the flag colors. If you want to remove the link settings, please right-click on the color editor in the shrink chart and select the material or all properties to further edit. ## Resetting Flag Colors If you want to apply a new sticker and reset all flag colors to the link state, you can press the Shift key on the keyboard while selecting the shrink chart to be modified, and in the object window, drag the new sticker file to link it to the project file. ## Conclusion When you are done, you can click on the color and add the color from the list. In the next page, you can see the color of the flag. If you want to make the color of the flag in the lower page, open the flag color project file in the 2024 version. Please click on the main menu, select "File," and save the option of the project file of the 2024.0 version separately for subsequent use. This feature update enhances the functions of the QIYISER editor, making it richer, more convenient, and efficient. Welcome to experience it!
